prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic streetwear portrait of an approved adult man standing in a narrow graffiti-covered urban alley.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man wearing an oversized dark charcoal graphic band T-shirt, light-blue distressed jeans with ripped knees, and worn grey low-top sneakers. One hand rests in his jeans pocket while the other lifts casually near his face.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered vertical portrait with colorful graffiti on both walls, narrow alley perspective, strong background depth, cinematic bokeh, and realistic worn surfaces.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural urban daylight with realistic contrast, relaxed street-style attitude, detailed cotton, denim, sneaker, brick, and graffiti texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic DSLR-style vertical portrait, shallow depth of field, sharp subject, natural proportions, realistic print texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a hyper-realistic vertical streetwear portrait of an approved adult man standing confidently in a narrow urban alley covered with colorful graffiti. He wears an oversized dark charcoal graphic band T-shirt, light-blue distressed ripped-knee jeans, and worn grey low-top sneakers. One hand rests in his front pocket and the other lifts near his face. Use realistic alley depth, colorful walls, cinematic bokeh, natural daylight, detailed fabric and print texture, and relaxed street attitude. Preserve shirt typography only with an explicit text-layout reference.
